prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 90.3%, median 3s / mean 567s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Companion Trait Studio & Live Preview Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a full-bleed interactive studio layout with real-time trait previews and live pet aesthetic validation. (why: Adoption stage has a 77.1% conversion rate with long completion times (mean 1017s) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or appearance issues.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Persistence Security Notice: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in binds their pet profile safely to cloud storage without data loss. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Verification & Live Spawn Progress: Enhance the waiting screen with live system readiness progress indicators and explicit desktop overlay loading feedback. (why: Home stage takes a mean of 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Control Command Center Screen: Introduce a dedicated interactive controls screen after home intro showing keyboard shortcuts and system tray actions to summon or hide the pet. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step conversion drops to 71.7%.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Compact Checklist Layout for Path Selection: Switch the path choice screen to a streamlined compact checklist format detailing the quick options for acquiring a companion. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s despite median 8s, suggesting some users stall on path selection details.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Fast-Track Preset Adoption Quick-Flow: Add an instant preset adoption button on the pet selection screen to let users skip custom photo setup if they want a fast launch. (why: Adoption screen drops to 77.1% conversion with a mean duration of 1017s.)
6: [finish, redesign] Celebratory Desktop Arrival & Quick Controls Redesign: Redesign home intro into a stage layout featuring mascot celebration animations and visible desktop control hints. (why: Finish stage conversion is 71.7% (median 395s / mean 5815s) and post-onboarding confusion around pet controls is high.)
7: [sign_in, wait_info] Sign-In System Diagnostic & Loading State: Add a visible progress status and connection hint to the sign-in screen to prevent perceived freezes during authentication. (why: 2 support tickets reported sign-in screen not appearing or app stalling before sign-in.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready System Tray Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification toggling on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet rendering completes even if app is minimized. (why: Mean waiting time on home stage is 2336s, indicating users minimize the app and get distracted during pet creation.)

scores.note: Full studio redesign addresses adoption drop and preview bugs but requires high implementation effort.
Simple security text notice directly targets 8 support complaints regarding missing pets.
Progress indicators reduce perceived freeze during the 2336s mean home loading step.
New control screen addresses high finish drop-off and support tickets, but adds an extra step.
Layout change targets long mean time on path choice, though support complaints are lacking.
Fast-track preset flow gives drop-off prone users an immediate path past long custom setup.
Redesigning finish stage targets the largest funnel drop step (71.7% conversion) with visible controls.
Diagnostic loading indicator solves reported stalling on sign-in stage.
Tray notification toggle re-engages users who minimize the app during 38-minute home wait.
